title: Landing page — Kazakhstan programme hero
description: Public homepage. Shows live counters (Notices Published, Suppliers Approved, Work Packages) and quick paths to browse open tenders or register as a supplier.

title: Notice board — all published tenders
description: Filterable list of every published notice: country, category, budget currency, submission deadline, EMD terms, contact.

title: Notice detail — full tender packet
description: Selecting any notice opens the public detail view with full description, documents, EMD/tender-fee summary, corrigenda log, Q&A, and download-tender-packet button.

title: Supplier registration
description: Public 'Register as supplier' onboarding — email/password, company details, country, licences, consent to data processing. Verification email dispatched on submit.

title: Unified sign-in — Choose your portal
description: Employees on the left (any staff role), suppliers on the right. Role selector routes admins to /admin and staff to /staff automatically.

title: Admin console landing (Operations Overview)
description: First screen after admin login — tab strip, environment chip, alerts, AI Copilot shortcut, security/2FA badge.

title: Admin · Dashboard analytics
description: KPIs, funnel drills, revenue by module, activity heatmap.

title: Admin · Vendor registrations queue
description: Approve, reject, resend activation, force-activate.

title: Admin · Vendor directory
description: Full CRUD on suppliers, licenses, compliance, tenants.

title: Admin · Notices — publish & manage
description: Create, publish, edit, withdraw, attach documents, EMD.

title: Admin · Corrigenda log
description: Publish addenda/amendments against any live notice.

title: Admin · Tender Builder & DPR AI
description: Master library, DPR deep-dive, AI Fill All, PDF export.

title: Admin · Bidding operations
description: Bid room, submissions, seal/unseal, timing.

title: Admin · Escrow / EMD desk
description: EMD receipts, forfeitures, refunds.

title: Admin · Evaluation & scoring
description: Technical + financial scoring, QCBS, L1 comparison.

title: Admin · Awards & POs
description: Letters of award, POs, contract award workflow.

title: Admin · DocuSign contracts
description: Envelope templates, signer routing, live status.

title: Admin · Reverse auctions
description: Live auction rooms, invitations, spectator link.

title: Admin · Pre-bid meetings
description: Scheduling, Zoom links, minutes, attendance.

title: Admin · BOQ templates & contracts
description: Bill of Quantities master + contract line items.

title: Admin · Vendor intel & ratings
description: Trust badges, moderation, criteria averages.

title: Admin · Masters — fees, roles, EMD
description: Fee slabs, staff roles, criteria, categories, countries.

title: Admin · Roles & permissions
description: Fine-grained ACL matrix.

title: Admin · Work packages
description: Modular deliverable packages for the KZ programme.

title: Admin · Audit trail
description: Immutable action log with entity filters.

title: Admin · Product catalog
description: UNSPSC-mapped goods catalog.

title: Admin · Consultant engagements
description: Retainer engagements, timesheets, invoices.

title: Tender Builder · AI DPR modal (v46g deep-dive)
description: Country-first DPR ingestion. When the country has no master, admins can borrow one from another country or build a brand-new master. Deep-dive (v46g) discovers 12–30 real chapters from the DPR and drafts each body.

title: Tender Builder · No-master options
description: When the picked country has no saved masters, an amber helper offers two options: (1) borrow a master from another country (all masters listed with country-code prefix), or (2) build a brand-new master from this DPR.

title: Vendor sign-in
description: Dedicated vendor login (also accessible via /login → right card).

title: Vendor dashboard landing
description: Overview of open tenders the vendor may bid on, invoice status, ratings tab, profile & licenses.
